ben: Anyone up for a Friday night watch + karaoke after the match? :soccer: :microphone:
maria: I'm in for the watch, karaoke depends on how much winning there is :grin:
devin: Count me in for the bar. Also quick fantasy thing — keeper rules: can we swap a keeper for a draft pick? reminded me of the league convo earlier
sam: We do 1 keeper per team, but trades that include a keeper are allowed. You'd lose the keeper status if you trade them, afaik. @maria correct me if i'm wrong
maria: Correct. Trade + keeper swap works but the receiving team must declare them as keeper before the draft window closes. Also note the multiplier change this year (1.5x on keepers)
jess: For the bar: The Taproom on 4th has the game on the projector. 8pm kickoff, i'll snag a table around 7:30. Who wants me to save seats? :beer:
ben: @jess please save 6 seats. i'll bring stickers for a tiny office bet pool :moneybag:
devin: Tiny office bet: loser buys first round, winner gets a ridiculous novelty hat. Deal? :raised_hands:
sam: Deal. Also @ben can you add a little poll? i'm torn between cheering for the underdog or the hometown team
ben: Poll: Who do you want to win? 1) Hometown 2) Underdog 3) Neither (just snacks) -- react with :one: :two: :three:
